column1: # Host table for scripts/fleet-gate-sweep.sh — READ-ONLY probe targets.
# The sweep runs exactly one command per host: `<binary> selfcheck --json`.
# That opens no data directory, binds no port, and writes nothing. Adding a
# host here grants no other access.
# Columns, tab-separated:
#   label <TAB> host <TAB> ssh_key_basename <TAB> binary_path <TAB> role
# `ssh_key_basename` is resolved under ~/.ssh. `role` is free text; the single
# row marked `ref` is the default reference the rest are compared against.
# WHY THE ARCHIVALS ARE LISTED FIRST AND SEPARATELY
# They serve the public RPC quorum and they are NOT on the fleet binary: the
# fleet moved to bloch-pos-cinco while the archivals stayed on
# bloch-pos-quatro. They are the population most likely to fork on a flag day
# and the least likely to be noticed doing it, because a wrong answer from an
# archival looks like an answer.
# The 7 "grandes" carry ~9 validators each (63 of 64) since the 2026-08-31
# migration off the classic boxes. One row per BOX, not per validator: every
# validator on a box runs the same binary file, so probing the box answers for
# all of them. If a box is ever split across two binaries, split the row.
# label
